name: Eclipse Balanceblade
description: Bow with the knife drawn flat to the forearm and read the whole room's hands before any cast.

name: Stickcrown
description: Throw from the formal stance with the free hand on the hip so the blade flies dead straight.

name: Deluge Stick
description: Slide along polished floor in small level steps that keep the shoulders from moving.

name: Thunderclap Spinetip
description: Spring a blade from the court sleeve in the middle of a bow so the first cast is unseen.

name: Peal Throwgrip
description: Skip a blade off a pillar's corner so it turns and strikes a foe who hides behind it.

name: Peal Pointguard
description: Turn the held knife in a small arc to knock aside a dart thrown at the chest.

name: Fearless Spineweight
description: Cast two blades along one line so they fall within a finger's width on the foe's guard.

name: Tenet Edgeflat
description: Throw a spread of blades into the floor to stand in a lattice that traps a walker's cloak.

name: Season Thunk
description: Cast a whole volley across the court chamber so every exit line is held by flying steel.

name: Intrepid Weighttang
description: The school's signature cast: one blade thrown from a bow's end that the court teaches as its final answer.

name: Squalllodge
description: Hold the feet in a wide shallow stance like water spread across a basin floor.

name: Unrivaled Flickthrow
description: Throw low along the ground so the blade skims the basin floor into the foe's shins.

name: Reminiscence Bladeflat
description: Breathe slowly and watch the foe's footing to see where the next step will fall.

name: Thunderclap Flight
description: Throw blades in widening ripples so each lands farther out than the last.

name: Parity Weighttang
description: Flow the guard knife along a cut and turn it round the thrower like water round a stone.

name: Despotic Spinthrow
description: Pin a foe's hem to the basin floor with a low throw so his step is caught and held.

name: Solarlean
description: Draw spent blades back toward the hand with a qi pull that gathers them like water in a pool.

name: Bedrock Lodge
description: Send a long low wave of blades across the floor so footing for the whole front is lost.

name: Shivpledge
description: Spread blades point-up across the ground so a rushing foe steps into them.

name: Inferno Bladeflat
description: Throw a rising flood of blades that climbs the foe's whole body from boots to brow.

name: Splendid Hiltweight
description: The school's signature: a flood of thrown blades that fills the floor of the field at once.

name: Eclipse Throwtang
description: Narrow the gaze to a single point on the foe and shut out everything beside it.

name: Inferno Throwtang
description: Throw at a chalk mark on the foe's coat so the blade lands within a thumb's width.

name: Solar Balanceblade
description: Hold the shoulders squared and still like folded wings before the mark is chosen.

name: Pealshiv
description: Throw with a silent wrist so no whistle of the blade warns the marked foe.

name: Prismflight
description: Pick one joint of the foe's armor with the eye and send a blade straight into that gap.

name: Squall Edgeflat
description: Circle the foe slowly like a hawk waiting on the wind until the exact moment arrives.

name: Thrall Flight
description: Pin the foe's heel to the ground so his turn is held for one needed breath.

name: Flightseal
description: Hold the gaze on one place and throw to another so the foe guards the wrong side.

name: Prism Thunk
description: Throw at a marked foe so that the blade follows each turn until it strikes.

name: Cunning Pointguard
description: Leave blades placed from a height so a foe who moves under them takes the fall.

name: Splendid Spinetip
description: Pick a quarry from the whole field and send one blade through the guard to the marked spot.

name: Paramount Hiltweight
description: The school's signature: one blade dropped silent and sudden on the marked foe from above the line of sight.

name: Squall Stick
description: Cast from the left hand along the left bank of motion with the right hand still.

name: Lordly Flickthrow
description: Cast from the right hand along the right bank of motion with the left hand still.

name: Swift Throwgrip
description: Step so the two wrists meet at the center and set up the joined throw.

name: Spinetip Verdict
description: Cast from each hand across the other's path so the blades cross at the foe's chest.

name: Prism Hiltweight
description: Take a thrown dart on the left blade and send it away along the right hand's path.

name: Masterful Spineweight
description: Pin a foe's two hands at once with a blade cast along each course of the river.

name: Millstone Spinthrow
description: Alternate the two hands' casts in a steady rhythm until their streams join over the foe.

name: Thrallslim
description: Cast two corded blades along crossing courses so the lines weave round the foe's body.

name: Flighttriumph
description: Pour both hands' casts together into one wide flood that no single guard can hold back.

name: Sovereign Weighttang
description: The school's signature: both hands' blades run separate courses and join in one wound at the mark.

name: Royal Bladeflat
description: Throw the first blade straight along the near track with the field wrapped round it.

name: Balanceblade Edict
description: Throw the second blade on a gentle curve along the far track beside the first.

name: Vigor Throwgrip
description: Reset both hands after a cast with a quick open of the fingers to feel the field once more.

name: Vigorthunk
description: Slide back on the line of one track while the other keeps the foe in range.

name: Seasonlodge
description: Hold two parallel streams of blades side by side so a foe cannot step between them.

name: Pallstick
description: Throw the tracks one beat apart so the foe guards the first and is struck by the second.

name: Unbending Pointguard
description: Throw the two tracks to clasp a foe's arm from above and below at once.

name: Statute Throwtang
description: Cast two rails of blades that stand parallel and close any lane between them to a walker.

name: Season Spinthrow
description: Chain barrages on the two tracks alternately so one is always flying while the other reloads.

name: Slimbanner
description: Fly both blades on tracks of full field strength so one covers the other's strike through a guard.

name: Thunk Decree
description: The school's signature: two blades on separate tracks are drawn into one and land as a single blow.

name: Interstice Pointguard
description: Stand tall with the arms open and feel the Core's qi reach far past the fingertips.

name: Leanedict
description: Throw a blade upward on a high arc that the Core's qi holds steady to its fall.

name: Bladeflat Largesse
description: Send a pulse from the Core to the wrist to loosen it before a series of fast casts.

name: Squall Flickthrow
description: Drop a thrown blade straight down from the top of an arc onto a foe beneath.

name: Shivboon
description: Rise on a step of qi to a higher footing from which the throw may fall.

name: Edgeflat Covenant
description: Spin the knife in a ring of Core qi to knock aside any blade that nears the thrower.

name: Thrall Lodge
description: Cast from the height of the Core's reach to pin a foe's cloak and boots to the earth.

name: Flightbanner
description: Hold the sky above the foe with a loose volley that falls whenever he steps from cover.

name: Dunethunk
description: Rain blades from the top of an arc over a whole front in one Core-driven cast.

name: Prismlean
description: Hold a lattice of cast blades in the air by the Core so it lowers on any who move beneath.

name: Vacuumlean
description: Throw at the very peak of the arc with all the Core's qi so the blade falls through a guard.

name: Solarshiv
description: The school's signature: a cast from the sky's high point whose fall covers all that the thrower can see.

name: Duneslim
description: Settle into a plain stance on both feet and feel which way the wind leans on the body.

name: Dauntless Thunk
description: Throw the first blade with the wind quartering from behind so it keeps a flat flight.

name: Dauntless Edgeflat
description: Whisper the oath at the draw and throw on the last syllable with no pause between.

name: Slimverdict
description: Lean into a gust and step aside on it with the cast so the foe's reply meets empty air.

name: Devout Spineweight
description: Turn a blow aside with the knife flat while the wind's push adds to the parry's swing.

name: Peerless Lodge
description: Throw wide of the foe so the wind drifts the blade back onto his unguarded side.

name: Entropy Spinthrow
description: Cut a banner's cord so the wind whips its cloth across the foe's face and eyes.

name: Spinetip Decree
description: Throw a spread of blades so the wind scatters them across a broad part of the field.

name: Snaring Throwtang
description: Plant blades upright along the wind's line so a crossing foe is cut by the gust-turned edges.

name: Throwgrip Decree
description: Throw one blade on the sworn wind so it passes the foe's raised guard from the side.

name: Magnificent Hiltweight
description: The school's signature: one thrown edge carried on the open wind to a mark the thrower swore to.

name: Squall Weighttang
description: Test the ground with the toe before settling weight so a loose stone cannot cost the throw.

name: Heroic Spineweight
description: Throw along a line sworn before the cast so the blade flies exactly on the vow.

name: Valiant Flickthrow
description: Lean the hip on a rim stone and throw along its edge so the arm has a fixed rest.

name: Prismshiv
description: Cross the feet along the plateau's top and cast at the cross so the body leans into it.

name: Peal Spinetip
description: Meet a strike with the knife while holding the oath so the parry does not give.

name: Thrall Stick
description: Pin a foe's hem at the plateau edge so his step toward the drop is caught.

name: Magnificent Stick
description: Cast sworn blades across the width of the plateau so the foe may not cross.

name: Thrall Balanceblade
description: Anchor the foe's cloak to bare stone with a blade the oath has made immovable.

name: Balanceblade Triumph
description: Throw a single sworn blade on a held breath that the oath does not let miss.

name: Triumphant Flickthrow
description: The school's signature: a throw made only after the oath is spoken and then never turned aside.

name: Squall Flight
description: Set the lead foot on a bearing stake and square the hips to the foe along it.

name: Inferno Pointguard
description: Speak the oath once in a level voice and cast at the end of the breath.

name: Hospitable Edgeflat
description: Hold the eyes on the bearing until the target is no longer separate from the line.

name: Noble Lodge
description: Throw with a firm breath held under heavy strain so no shake enters the arm.

name: Parity Throwgrip
description: Hold the knife bound to the oath by a thread of qi so it will not leave the hand unsworn.

name: Revered Weighttang
description: Turn on the bearing to take a cut on the guard knife and loose a throw down the same line.

name: Fettering Thunk
description: Fasten a foe's sleeve to a post with a throw sworn to hold through all his pulling.

name: Bedrock Stick
description: Chain throws on two bearings so the foe cannot guard both lines at once.

name: Guileful Throwtang
description: Cast blades along a bearing to stand in a corridor of edges that holds a lane shut.

name: Illustrious Spinthrow
description: Pierce a guard with a blade whose oath does not allow the hand to yield under blows.

name: Lodge Edict
description: Cast a single qi-edged blade at full bearing and oath so it cannot be turned.

name: Slimtriumph
description: The school's signature: one sworn cast on a held bearing that no guard in the field may turn.

name: Deluge Flight
description: Stand on open ground in plain view and keep the stance so no weakness shows to the foe.

name: Pulsar Spinthrow
description: Take a long pace into the cast so the blade carries to the far limit of the arm.

name: Pulsarslim
description: Measure the distance to the paces and throw at precisely the reach that fits.

name: Squallslim
description: Retreat along the skyline one pace at a time to keep the long throw available.

name: Parity Hiltweight
description: Cast into the foe's lunge so his own forward step carries him onto the blade.

name: Volition Flight
description: Throw in steady order across the plain so the foe is held at the edge of reach.

name: Imperious Flight
description: Pin a foe's boot from far off so he has to stoop or be dragged off balance.

name: Tempestuous Spinetip
description: Scatter blades across the open plain so no spot remains for a foe to stand secure.

name: Leantroth
description: Stand blades upright across the plain so a rushing foe impales himself on the line.

name: Vaunted Balanceblade
description: Hold the field's entire front with a continuous fall of blades so none may close.

name: Triumphant Edgeflat
description: The school's signature: a field held shut by the reach of thrown steel alone with no cover.

name: Compassionate Spineweight
description: Look up and read the sky's wind before the cast so its push is accounted for.

name: Thunderclap Throwgrip
description: Hurl the blade in a high arc under open sky so it falls onto a distant foe.

name: Bedrock Weighttang
description: Step with the wind along the field's edge to carry the body to a clear cast.

name: Sticktriumph
description: Throw into a steady lane of gale so it carries the blade past a foe's reach.

name: Clement Pointguard
description: Let an updraft lift a falling blade back into the hand to be thrown once more.

name: Parity Spineweight
description: Throw into a blow from above so the gale's pull helps carry it from the thrower.

name: Sovereign Hiltweight
description: Rain blades on the gale so the wind spreads them over the foe's whole front.

name: Beguiling Bladeflat
description: Cast blades on the gale to fall in a lane of cutting edges that holds any crossing foe.

name: Vacuumstick
description: Throw under the full open sky so the gale places the blade where the eye reads it.

name: Imperial Thunk
description: The school's signature: one thrown edge that the gale itself carries the last distance to the mark.

name: Peal Bladeflat
description: Align the body with the bearing and let the Core's qi settle along that line.

name: Prism Stick
description: Release with a loose Core-driven arm so the blade leaves with no strain at all.

name: Twilit Throwgrip
description: Step in soft arcs that keep the hips on the same bearing through every shift.

name: Vaunted Thunk
description: Cast high into the wind on a line held rigid by the Core's qi.

name: Gallant Pointguard
description: Throw with Core qi along the bearing so the blade does not shift in any wind.

name: Phantasm Throwtang
description: Take a thrown dart on the blade and return it along the same bearing it came on.

name: Thralllean
description: Pin a foe's cloak from a high release so it holds him against the ground below.

name: Magnificent Spinetip
description: Link casts one after another along one bearing so the foe is pressed down a single lane.

name: Inferno Flickthrow
description: Cast from a high release so a rain of blades falls along the bearing and spreads over the front.

name: Shivtroth
description: Hold a lattice of edges along the bearing by the Core so it closes on any who cross.

name: Flightdecree
description: Throw at the peak of the release with Core qi so the blade holds its bearing through any gale.

name: Shivdecree
description: The school's signature: the highest release of the thrown edge held on one bearing to the mark.
